blocks.text: Stage evidence was verified at 00:08:07 UTC on 27 October 2026. This is an AI-assisted engineering record. The research program has been delivered and approved implementation is underway. No new production-model training has begun.

The goal is a model trained from scratch that uses logic in new settings, beyond convincing conversation. Planning tasks were one check of that goal. Earlier planning and reflection failures remain in the record; clarifying the goal does not change them.

The research starting point remains the 97,536,768-value model trained from random values on 100 million usable targets. Its original save and tokenizer are preserved. Later task-trained models and the model served by the interface are tracked separately.

The first implementation step is a small public development check of typed facts with ordered corrections and finite unary logic. An independently written reference agreed with a separate checker on 3,316 cases. Another 800 generated-label comparisons agreed with it. That checks the measurement code, not a model's reasoning.

A fixed public development set has 32 cases: 16 binding tasks and 16 logic tasks. With the original tokenizer, full prompts take 550–685 input pieces. Each fits the 768-piece input limit and the 1,024-piece total context with 128 pieces reserved for answers.

The first guarded control job finished successfully at 00:03:20 UTC. Correct controls scored 32/32, deliberately wrong controls 0/32, and an always-abstaining control 3/32 overall and 0/26 on answerable cases. These check the test itself, not model skill. A brief timing race occurred while recording exit. Read-only checks confirmed that same job's results, and its record was fixed without rerunning it. The hidden final planning test remains untouched.
The current Gutenberg-derived text stays held back, and that approval effort is stopped. No encoding-repair batch or new source download is continuing on that branch.

The limited PMC download finished 240 more XML responses; saved sizes and fingerprints were verified. Initial extraction, including earlier fixtures, produced 231 candidate records. Known extraction and context problems blocked approval. Further independent review is now blocked by a platform restriction, so no repaired collection is cleared. We are not fetching more or using another route to continue that review.
No new records or tokens are approved. Download and candidate counts do not establish usable training data. The earlier fixture review does not clear the larger collection.

The dedicated data allowance is 800GB in decimal units and counts total usage. After local writer and accounting checks, all 170 Linux integration tests passed without skips at 00:01 UTC. They covered restart, budget charges, and guards. Earlier device-visibility and import-packaging failures remain recorded with the passing attempt.

A guarded, unchanging 47-byte test file was staged successfully at 00:04:55 UTC. Its fingerprint and accounting matched, with no reservations left outstanding. This is a small staging check, not a test of trainer storage or data migration. Existing filesystem protections remain active.

A 4,096-target engineering check is being prepared, with 8,192 physical tokens reserved. It has not launched. It stays within the existing 200-million-additional-target limit. Preparing it neither raises the cap nor approves blocked text.

Data approval stays closed while review is blocked. The project deadline remains 31 October 2026 at 04:12 UTC; the separate interface cutoff remains 27 October at 17:02:37 UTC. Neither is extended. The time above marks verified stage evidence, not live resource readings.
